methods.paired_controls: Match repetition: candidate repeat 1 with 12x1 repeat 1, repeat 2 with repeat 2.
methods.checkpoint: caseResults/class totals persist only after a whole browser batch completes. notRun can include executed but unreported tests in the active batch. Failed counts are lower bounds for incomplete runs; rates describe only the reported subset and do not bound the final full-run rate.
methods.flakes: Only explicit first-pass failed then diagnostic passed counts as confirmed flake. Missing retries, >3 failures per shard, interrupted execution and missing reports are unknown. Observed confirmed/recorded-run rates are descriptive only; complete-run flake rates and their differences remain null.
methods.memory: Completed process records show only completed acquisitions. No OOM log is not proof of no OOM; cgroup counters are unavailable. Missing final summaries and cleanup after timeout remain unknown.
methods.native_workers: Merged blob config.workers and Running N tests using M workers sum per-chunk workers; they are not simultaneous concurrency. Inspect effective experiment policy and native parallelIndex slots.
methods.non_case: Use interval union for per-launch wall minus active test intervals. Do not subtract summed worker-seconds. Existing tier nonCaseSeconds is serial-only and ignored for parallel batches.
